sessions.phase_label: Brand brief clarification and initial logo concepts
Logo selection and detailed visual revisions
Final asset delivery, remediation, brand references, and copyright documentation

requirements.title: Initial Logo Concept Set
requirements.definition: Creation of the requested initial logo concepts, predominantly typography-led with no more than one concept using a subtle graphic element.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently requested initial concept deliverable and its start or deferral; later refinements to the selected composition belong to the final visual-design Requirement.

requirements.title: Logo Name and Strapline
requirements.definition: The logo must identify the business as 'Global Dough', exclude 'truck' from the business name, and include the strapline 'Seriously Tasty Street Food'.
requirements.boundary_note: Wording is independently changeable brand content; letterform styling, color, and composition remain attributes of the visual-design Requirement.

requirements.title: Logo Visual Design
requirements.definition: The final logo must provide a clean, bold, legible, minimalist modern-retro composition with characterful typography and the client-selected colors and letterform treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: Flame treatment, word sizing, graduated orange, strapline prominence, and individual letter shapes are coupled attributes of one selected logo composition rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Original and Trademark-Suitable Artwork
requirements.definition: The final logo artwork must be original and suitable for trademark use, without stock logos, copyrighted elements, templates, or AI-generated final artwork.
requirements.boundary_note: Artwork originality is an independently enforceable acceptance constraint; the separate copyright certificate documents ownership rather than determining the visual design.

requirements.title: Boxed and Unboxed Logo Variants
requirements.definition: The final logo package must include versions both with the black background box and without it for uses where the box is unsuitable.
requirements.boundary_note: Background treatment can be delivered or modified independently of the requested full-color, black, and white color variants.

requirements.title: Full-Color, Black, and White Logo Variants
requirements.definition: The final package must provide the standard full-color, black, and white logo versions, with the selected graduated-orange and black treatment serving as the primary logo.
requirements.boundary_note: The three requested color variants form one variant set; boxed versus unboxed output is a separate independently requested dimension.

requirements.title: Usable Raster Logo Files
requirements.definition: The final logo package must include usable raster outputs, including transparent-background PNG and JPG files, suitable for online and other applicable uses.
requirements.boundary_note: Raster rendering and transparent-background behavior have their own usability trajectory; editable vector and source formats are independently deliverable.

requirements.title: Editable Vector and Source Logo Files
requirements.definition: The final package must include the requested editable vector and source formats, including AI, EPS, and SVG, suitable for print, signage, and future editing.
requirements.boundary_note: Groups editable vector/source formats as one delivery mechanism while excluding raster-display behavior, which can fail or be repaired independently.

requirements.title: Brand Color Specification
requirements.definition: The delivery must identify the selected brand colors and supply accessible color codes that can be reused consistently in future materials.
requirements.boundary_note: Color values and their accessible documentation can be delivered or fail independently of typography guidance and logo artwork files.

requirements.title: Brand Typography Guidance
requirements.definition: The delivery must explain the logo lettering or font basis and provide suitable complementary font recommendations for websites, headings, and other brand materials.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers reusable font information and complementary-font recommendations; custom letterform styling within the logo remains part of the visual-design Requirement.

requirements.title: Copyright Transfer Certificate
requirements.definition: Provision of written documentation confirming transfer of logo copyright to the client for ownership records and future trademark use.
requirements.boundary_note: The certificate is an independently requested documentation artifact; its additional price and milestone administration are excluded from Requirement state.
